glossaryIntro: The terms of this app, from A to Z, each with the page that explains it.
sourcesIntro: The facts in this app come from these sources:
workedTasks: Three worked tasks, each with its solution:
practice: Practise yourself, with new tasks each time:
backToTutorOpen: Switch back to the chat with {name}.
backToTutorCopied: Switch back to {name} and paste it there. You may leave this tab open.
backToTutorFailed: Copying did not work. Copy the selected lines, switch back to {name} and paste them there.
stuckAsk: Load {url} and help me with exercise {exercise}{number}. I am stuck.
stuckPrivacy: With your click, “Why?” gives {name} the task, your input and the app's message.
stuckPrivacyCopy: Your click copies the task, your input and the app's message for the chat with your tutor; the app sends nothing anywhere.
stuckCopied: Switch back to {name} and paste the lines there.
stuckFailed: Copying did not work. Copy the selected lines, switch back to {name} and paste them there.
tutorAbout: An AI tutor is an AI assistant of your choice that accompanies you while you learn with this app. It explains the topic with the examples of the pages, gives you tasks from the app and helps you when you are stuck. You solve the tasks in the app: it checks your answers.
tutorAboutStart: Choose your assistant here. It is then ready under the title of every page, and every exercise has the button “Help”. You can also switch it on under the title of a page.
tutorAboutPrivacy: Your choice stays on this device; only your click opens the assistant. Ask your parents or teacher whether you may use it.
tutorAccount: You use your own account with the provider. The assistant is not offered by lernapps.net: lernapps only provides the content and the exercises.
tutorScope: The choice holds for all pages, on this device only.
tutorPageIntro: An AI tutor explains this page to you and helps you with the exercises. Choose your assistant:
tutorPageLink: See what your tutor gets for this page
tutorPasteHint: {name} does not load web pages when the link comes from a button. So we copy the sentence with the link for you. A click on “Learn with {name}” opens {name} with a short message. Then paste the copied sentence (Ctrl+V, ⌘+V on a Mac) and send it.
tutorCopied: The prompt is copied. Paste it into the chat of your AI assistant.
tutorCopyFailed: Copying did not work. Try again.
videoNote: Playing it sends data to YouTube/Google, among them your IP address.
assessmentOfferApp: Optional: before you start, you can solve {count} tasks from this app. At the end you see for each page whether you should look at it more closely.
assessmentOfferChapter: Optional: before you start, you can solve {count} tasks from this chapter. At the end you see for each page whether you should look at it more closely.
assessmentIntro: With this self-assessment, {count} tasks give you an overview of what you know already.
assessmentLeftOut: It does not ask about {n} pages. So they are worth a look:
assessmentLeftOutOne: It does not ask about one page. So it is worth a look:
assessmentHow: The app does not tell you for each task whether it is right. Only at the end do you see for each page asked whether you know it already. What you leave empty counts as not known.
assessmentPrivacy: Your result stays on this device only. A new start replaces it.
assessmentScorePartly: You solved {right} of {total} tasks right and {partly} partly.
assessmentAdvice: Start with the pages you should read closely.
assessmentAllKnown: You probably know the pages asked already. Practise on the pages anyway, so that it sticks.
assessmentTutorTitle: Go on learning with an AI tutor
assessmentTutorIntro: With your result, an AI tutor can go through the pages with you that do not stick yet. Your click gives it the result and your inputs; apart from that the app sends nothing.
assessmentAsk: Load {url} and be my tutor. I did the self-assessment. My result per page:
assessmentBackIntro: Press “Back to the tutor”. It copies your result. Paste it into the chat with your tutor.
assessmentBackLine: I did the self-assessment. My result per page:
assessmentTutorRun: This round is for your tutor: the app keeps nothing of it.
sessionNone: I have not solved a task on {url} yet.
assessmentLinks: Links for my tutor, take exactly these:
openTaskPaperHow: Write your answer on a sheet of paper. Then take a photo of it.
openTaskPhoto: Take a photo of the sheet
openTaskPhotoLocal: The photo stays on this device: the app neither keeps nor sends it.
openTaskWriteFirst: Write your answer first. Then you can compare.
openTaskPhotoFirst: Take a photo of your sheet first. Then you can compare.
openTaskRight: Right: all {total} points are in your answer.
openTaskPartly: Partly: {n} of {total} points are in your answer.
openTaskWrong: Not yet: none of the {total} points is in your answer.
openTaskLocked: The solution opens after your answer.
